postings.title: Account Development Representative
postings.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. 
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 


Key Responsibilities
- 

Target Strategic Growth Accounts: Research and map prospective organizations, decision-makers, and buying committees across EMEA to uncover high-impact maritime opportunities.

- 

Execute Multi-Channel Campaigns: Design and run outreach sequences across phone, email, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp to articulate Kpler’s value proposition to executive stakeholders.

- 

Qualify Meaningful Pipeline: Apply the BANT framework to assess organizational fit, identify client pain points, and qualify prospective buyers effectively.

- 

Drive Commercial Momentum: Secure discovery meetings for Account Executives, ensuring seamless prospect handoffs and a healthy sales pipeline.

- 

Partner Cross-Functionally: Collaborate weekly with Account Executives, Marketing, and Business Development leadership to align outreach strategies with regional campaigns and product launches.

- 

Maintain Operational Rigor: Record pipeline updates, outreach insights, and prospect data within Salesforce to ensure data accuracy and cross-team visibility.

Experience & Background
What you'll need (Must-haves):

- 

2+ years of outbound prospecting or business development experience within a B2B SaaS or technology environment.

- 

Proven track record of consistently achieving outbound activity targets, booking discovery meetings, and generating qualified pipeline.

- 

Strong multi-channel outreach capabilities, with comfort initiating conversations over the phone, email, and social channels.

- 

Clear, professional communication skills in English, with the confidence to engage and influence industry professionals.

Nice-to-haves:

- 

Direct familiarity with the Maritime, Logistics, Supply Chain, or Energy & Commodities sectors.

- 

Practical experience working with sales tools such as Salesforce, Outreach, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

- 

Working knowledge of standard B2B qualification methodologies (e.g., BANT).

- 

Professional working proficiency in additional European languages.

postings.title: Account Executive - Insurance & Risk
postings.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. 
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 


About the Role
The Sales team is looking for a highly motivated Account Executive, Insurance (New Business) who is excited about selling a disruptive technology solution into marine underwriters, P&I clubs, cargo insurers, and the brokers and surveyors who support them.
This is a hunter role,. You will own 70%+ of your own pipeline generation through outbound prospecting, close $30K-$150K+ ARR deals with multi-stakeholder buying committees, and build the relationships and playbook that establish Kpler as the standard for vessel and voyage-risk visibility in the insurance market — largely through in-person meetings across the New York/Connecticut insurance corridor, with additional coverage in Houston.




Key Responsibilities
- 

Own the full sales cycle: prospect new business, develop opportunities, demo the product, and close sales across marine underwriters, P&I clubs, cargo insurers, and brokerages in the United States

- 

Generate 60%+ of pipeline through outbound prospecting (30+ meaningful touches/day minimum), anchored around in-person meetings

- 

Build multi-threaded relationships across the buying committee — underwriting, claims, loss prevention, and risk/compliance — not single-threaded

- 

Sell to economic buyers (VP/C-level: Chief Underwriting Officer, VP Claims), not just end-users or surveyors

- 

Translate vessel-tracking and voyage-risk data into concrete underwriting, claims, and loss-prevention value

- 

Collaborate with the global Sales team, Product, and Market Analysts to build the insurance-vertical playbook and close strategic deals

- 

Provide accurate forecasts (90%+ commit accuracy expected)

- 

Close new business consistently at or above quota level

Who You'll Sell To
Primary buyer personas include:

- 

Marine underwriters and Chief Underwriting Officers at insurance carriers and MGAs

- 

P&I Club claims and loss-prevention teams

- 

Marine claims adjusters and surveyors

- 

Cargo and hull insurance brokers

- 

Risk and compliance teams evaluating sanctions, casualty, or voyage-risk exposure

What Success Looks Like
- 

Built and maintained territory/account plan for the insurance vertical within the first 60-90 days

- 

Consistent quarter-over-quarter pipeline growth and quota attainment against a defined new-business target

- 

A cadence of in-person meetings booked and run each month across the target account list

- 

Documented, repeatable playbook (messaging, objection handling, proof points) that can be handed to future insurance-vertical hires

What We're Looking For
- 

3+ years of closing experience in B2B SaaS or data/analytics sales, ideally with a full-cycle (hunter) sales motion

- 

Experience selling into insurance, reinsurance, or InsurTech — direct marine/P&I experience is a strong plus but not required

- 

Comfortable building a new vertical from scratch: prospecting, messaging, and process, not just working an inbound queue

- 

Strong in-person presence — this role is built around face-to-face meetings, not a purely virtual motion

- 

Ability to learn and speak credibly about maritime risk, vessel operations, and underwriting workflows

- 

Willingness and ability to travel regularly (up to ~30-40%) within the Southeast US, with occasional national/industry-event travel

Nice to Have
- 

Existing relationships with marine underwriters, P&I clubs, or marine claims/surveying firms

- 

Background in maritime, logistics, or supply-chain data products

- 

Experience selling AIS, vessel-tracking, geospatial, or risk-analytics data products

The Sales team is looking for a highly motivated Account Executive who is excited about selling Kpler’s maritime intelligence platform — AIS vessel tracking, port and terminal visibility, container and cargo intelligence — into the software and technology sector. You’ll hunt new logos among companies that want to embed, resell, or build on top of live maritime and vessel data: supply chain risk and visibility platforms, procurement and logistics software vendors, broader data and analytics companies that need vessel-level signal (dark activity, port congestion, ETAs, ownership and flag data) to power their own products.

postings.description:
Kpler is investing in dedicated new-logo hunting capacity across the Metals & Agriculture vertical, and this Account Executive will be one of the first dedicated hunters focused exclusively on landing new customers across the sector. This role carries a 100% new-business quota focused on new-logo acquisition. Success is measured entirely on net-new logos and net-new revenue.
You will build your own pipeline from the ground up: mapping target accounts, prospecting into metals producers, traders, agricultural merchandisers, and analytics teams, and running the full new-business sales cycle from first outreach to signature.


 Key Responsibilities
- 

Own 100% new-business pipeline generation — build and execute a territory plan for net-new logo acquisition across Metals & Agriculture producers, traders, processors, and merchandisers in North America.

- 

Self-source a majority of your own pipeline — prospecting, outbound campaigns, and account mapping to identify and prioritize target accounts and buying committees within them.

- 

Run the complete new-business sales cycle — discovery, demo, business-case building, negotiation, and close — for every new-logo opportunity you create.

- 

Multi-thread every target account from day one — reach heads of trading, supply and logistics leaders, risk and analytics teams, and commercial/competitive intelligence functions to understand workflows and tailor the Kpler and Maritime product pitch.

- 

Represent Kpler in-market — attending industry events and conferences, and building a credible personal network across the North American metals and agriculture trading community.

- 

Partner cross-functionally — with Product, Sales Engineering, Market Analysts, and Customer Success to sharpen positioning, win themes, and onboarding handoff for newly closed accounts.

- 

Forecast and report with discipline — every new-logo opportunity in the CRM, with clean staging, next steps, and close-date discipline.

- 

Consistently meet or exceed — a net-new logo bookings quota every quarter; this role has no renewal or expansion credit.

Who You'll Sell To
Primary buyer personas for net-new acquisition include:

- 

Heads of trading and trading desks at metals producers, agricultural merchandisers, processors, and marketers

- 

Commercial, supply, and logistics teams evaluating new data and analytics providers

- 

Risk, analytics, and market intelligence functions

- 

Business/competitive intelligence teams currently underserved by, or unhappy with, an incumbent provider

- 

Economic buyers — VP Commercial, Chief Commercial Officer, Director of Trading, Head of Supply & Trading

What Success Looks Like
- 

A documented target-account list and territory map for the Metals & Agriculture vertical within the first 30-60 days

- 

A qualified new-logo pipeline sufficient to cover quota within the first 90 days

- 

Consistent, predictable net-new logo bookings quarter over quarter

- 

A repeatable outbound playbook (messaging, sequencing, objection handling) for the Metals & Agriculture segment that can scale as the team grows

  What We're Looking For
- 

5-7+ years of sales experience in a full-cycle, new-business sales role — SaaS, data/analytics, or market intelligence strongly preferred.

- 

A demonstrated track record of hunting for pipeline generation — you have consistently self-sourced a significant share of the opportunities you've closed, not relied primarily on inbound or an existing book.

- 

Experience selling into metals, mining, agriculture, commodities, or trading markets, or a closely adjacent space (financial data, market intelligence, trade-flow, supply chain, or risk analytics platforms).

- 

Comfort running the full sales cycle independently: prospecting, discovery, demo, negotiation, and close

- 

Strong consultative selling and communication skills, with the ability to multi-thread across trading, risk, commercial, and analytics stakeholders

- 

A builder's mindset — energized by creating a territory and playbook from scratch rather than inheriting one

- 

Based in, or willing to relocate to, Miami, New York City, or Houston; able to travel across North America

Nice to Have
- 

Existing relationships with trading, commercial, or risk teams at North American metals or agricultural companies

- 

Familiarity with Kpler or comparable commodity, trade-flow, or maritime data platforms (AIS, freight, storage, or trade-flow data)

- 

Experience selling into base metals, precious metals, mining, grains, oilseeds, softs, or maritime-adjacent markets

postings.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. 
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 


About the Role
As a Senior Software Engineer within our Commodities tribe, you will lead the end-to-end integration of US inland waterway barge data into Kpler’s global cargo intelligence platform. Operating under a "you build it, you run it" philosophy, you will design robust ingestion paths, stream real-time data using Kafka, and connect barge movement models directly to our customer-facing surfaces. This role carries genuine design authority, empowering you to solve complex entity resolution problems while mentoring peers and elevating technical craft across our crews.


Key Responsibilities
- 

Lead end-to-end integration architecture: Drive the full engineering lifecycle—from external feed ingestion and domain modeling to streaming, entity resolution, and UI distribution.

- 

Design robust ingestion & entity-resolution systems: Map incoming barge data onto Kpler reference data (vessels, zones, installations, products) using existing Elasticsearch and PostgreSQL matching patterns.

- 

Build scalable Kafka streaming pipelines: Construct event-driven contracts, schemas (Avro), deduplication mechanisms, and dead-letter queue replays with Python and Scala.

- 

Deliver data across customer surfaces: Surface integrated barge data cleanly across Elasticsearch read models, external APIs, data warehouse feeds, and the Kpler Terminal (TypeScript/Vue).

-

Strong problem-solving skills with a high degree of agency to move from ambiguous requirements to working code.

Your work will underpin our core products and commercial decisions by ensuring that vessel-level data is accurate, consistent and comprehensive.
Combining hands-on data curation with independent analysis, you will research and validate information from multiple sources, identify data gaps and anomalies, and develop processes to improve data quality. You will take ownership of specific vessel data domains while helping automate recurring tasks and strengthen the reliability of our data pipelines.
Working closely with the Vessel Data Manager, Market Analysts, Product and Engineering teams, you will contribute to continuous improvements in our vessel data capabilities and ensure that our datasets meet the needs of internal teams and customers.




Responsibilities 
- Own the end-to-end quality of assigned vessel particulars datasets, including specifications, ownership, classification and technical attributes.

- Research and validate vessel data from multiple sources, ensuring accuracy, consistency and completeness.

- Analyse datasets to identify data gaps and anomalies, developing and running validation checks to improve data quality and coverage.

- Create and maintain SQL- and Python-based workflows to automate recurring data collection, cleansing and enrichment tasks.

- Develop dashboards and reports to monitor vessel data quality, providing Market Analysts with relevant vessel-level insights.

- Support the integration of new vessel data sources, including scoping, testing and validating incoming data feeds.

- Investigate and resolve data quality issues raised by internal teams or customers, identifying root causes and implementing fixes.

- Document data logic, business rules and definitions to ensure consistency and adherence to vessel particulars data standards.

- Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to translate data quality findings into platform and pipeline improvements.

- Work proactively with the Vessel Data Manager, taking ownership of issues independently, communicating clearly and recommending solutions.

Skills and Experience 
- 2–4 years of experience in a data analyst, data quality or data operations role.

- Experience working with SQL for data querying, cleansing and analysis.

- Demonstrable knowledge of vessel data and maritime shipping concepts.

- Experience working with large, real-world datasets, particularly vessel particulars.

- Experience in the maritime industry.

- Strong analytical skills, with a structured and detail-oriented approach to problem-solving.

- Experience with data validation, monitoring and quality-improvement techniques.

- Strong ownership and accountability, with the ability to work independently and prioritise effectively.

- Clear communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to have 
- Familiarity with data visualisation tools and dashboarding.

- Practical experience with ETL processes and/or web scraping for data collection.

- Experience using Python for data analysis and automation.

- Experience working with APIs for data ingestion and validation.

- Experience building or maintaining data pipelines.

- Familiarity with maritime data sources.

Contribute to the crew's shared frameworks and to AI-assisted engineering practices a

- 

Understanding of system design, databases/data modelling, and application architecture.

- LLM application development: model APIs, prompt/context engineering, basic RAG patterns.

Experience integrating third-party SaaS APIs.

- 

Full-stack experience — building web UIs as well as their supporting backend services.

- 

Experience building internal or developer-facing tools.

- 

Exposure to LLM evaluation, observability, or prompt/context engineering.

postings.title: Engineering Manager - Commodities
postings.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. 
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 


The Commodities Tribe builds the systems that turn fragmented maritime, cargo and market data into a real-time view of how commodities are moving around the world. Our platforms process complex and often incomplete data at scale, powering products, APIs and analytical workflows used by customers and internal experts to understand global trade. 
As a Lead Engineer, you will lead teams at the centre of this domain as we modernise a business-critical platform and move towards a more modular, scalable and AI-native architecture. You will be responsible for building a high-performing and sustainable engineering environment: developing people, improving delivery, strengthening operational ownership and enabling Technical Leads and senior engineers to make strong technical decisions. The role is well suited to either an existing Engineering Manager or an experienced Technical Lead or senior engineer ready to take their first formal step into management.


Your mission is to
- Guide the teams through the platform transformation, helping engineers understand, influence and adopt the new direction.

- Partner with Product and domain stakeholders to shape the roadmap around customer value, data quality and business outcomes.

- Develop Technical Leads and senior engineers, delegating decisions to the people with the strongest context while keeping accountability clear.

- Maintain enough technical depth to lead credibly, challenge assumptions and support sound decision-making without becoming the default technical owner.

- Set clear goals, milestones and delivery rhythms with the teams, balancing roadmap commitments with technical debt and platform health.

- Build strong end-to-end operational ownership, including on-call, runbooks, incident response and follow-up actions.

- Improve reliability and observability across the cargo data platform, addressing gaps in monitoring, alerting and data integrity.

- Lead significant incidents affecting the domain and ensure contributing factors are understood and acted on.

- Shape and grow your team through effective hiring, capability planning and interviewer development.

- Develop and retain engineers through coaching, actionable feedback, meaningful goals and fair performance management.

You could be a match if you have
- Experience leading a software engineering team, whether as an Engineering Manager, Technical Lead, acting manager or senior engineer with meaningful responsibility for delivery and the development of others.

- Strong technical foundations in backend, data or distributed systems, with enough depth to review designs, challenge assumptions and coach engineers through complex technical decisions.

- Ability to work effectively with Product, engineering and domain stakeholders to translate business priorities into clear technical and delivery outcomes.

- Experience contributing to the operation of production systems, including on-call practices, incident response, monitoring and follow-up improvements.

- A strong belief in end-to-end engineering ownership, including the reliability, maintainability and operational impact of the systems a team builds.

- A track record of setting clear goals, coordinating delivery and creating accountability within an engineering team.

- Experience supporting the growth and performance of engineers through regular feedback, development goals and constructive handling of difficult situations.

- Some involvement in hiring or technical interviewing, with the ability to assess candidates fairly and provide clear, evidence-based feedback.

Desirable:

- Experience leading or contributing to the migration, modernisation or re-architecture of a long-lived production system while maintaining continuity for its users.

- Experience with data-intensive, event-driven or ML-adjacent systems, such as data pipelines, Kafka, optimisation engines or systems where data and model correctness are central to the product.

- Familiarity with Python and one or more JVM-based technologies, such as Java or Scala, or experience working effectively in a polyglot environment.

- Experience partnering with Product at roadmap level, helping shape priorities rather than working solely from predefined requirements.

- Experience developing Technical Leads or senior engineers and delegating technical ownership effectively.

- Exposure to domains such as commodities, energy, logistics or financial markets, where data quality, timeliness and operational reliability are particularly important.

postings.description:

About the Role
As an Enterprise Account Manager for Energy in Houston, you will serve as the global account owner for Kpler’s most strategic oil & gas accounts headquartered in the region. You will champion executive relationships across trading, commercial, risk, and analytics functions globally to protect and expand recurring revenue across complex enterprise portfolios. By uniting Kpler's cross-functional Product, Market Analyst, and Customer Success teams behind each client’s strategic roadmap, you will position Kpler's intelligence as an indispensable commercial advantage for world-leading energy organizations.


Key Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities

- 

Own global strategy, retention, and revenue expansion across a portfolio of top-tier oil & gas enterprise accounts headquartered in Houston.

- 

Build and execute global account plans and stakeholder maps to capture revenue whitespace across trading, risk, supply, and market intelligence teams globally.

- 

Partner with C-suite executives, heads of trading, and commercial leaders to demonstrate Kpler’s full product suite and drive solution adoption across international business units.

- 

Align cross-functional internal teams—including Product, Market Analysts, Customer Success, and Sales leadership—to deliver seamless account execution and escalation resolution.

- 

Lead Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) and renewal negotiations, presenting compelling ROI and value-delivered models across the client's global footprint.

- 

Maintain a visible, trusted presence within the Houston energy community while coordinating global account strategies across regional offices.

- 

Deliver accurate revenue forecasting and consistently achieve or exceed retention and expansion quota targets.

Experience & Background
- 

7+ years of experience in enterprise account management or strategic commercial sales within energy software, SaaS, or market data/analytics.

- 

Proven credibility and an active network across major Houston-based oil & gas producers, marketers, and energy trading organizations.

- 

Demonstrated track record of retaining and expanding revenue across complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise accounts operating globally.

- 

Strong proficiency in structured account planning, executive relationship management, and cross-functional leadership across time zones.

Nice-to-haves:

- 

Direct familiarity with commodity trade-flow platforms, maritime data (AIS, freight, storage), or energy risk and market intelligence tools.

- 

Experience navigating multi-region commercial structures across crude, refined products, LNG, or maritime-adjacent energy markets.

postings.title: Full Stack Engineer
postings.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. 
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 


About the Role
As a Mid Full-Stack Engineer at Kpler, you will play a pivotal role in building and scaling the core systems and internal tools that power our product ecosystem. Working across the full software stack, you will construct resilient PHP backend services—including our Stripe-driven payments and subscription billing infrastructure—while crafting responsive, user-friendly frontend interfaces with React and TypeScript. Partnering closely with Product, Finance, Revenue Operations, and CRM teams, your work will directly optimize operational workflows and elevate the experience of our global users.


Key Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities

- 

Architect backend services: Build and maintain high-performing backend services in PHP with clean domain boundaries, specifically managing billing and application management systems. 

- 

Craft responsive frontend user experiences: Design and implement polished, accessible user interfaces using React, TypeScript, and Node.js. 

- 

Ensure production reliability & test coverage: Safeguard core functionality by writing comprehensive end-to-end (E2E) automated tests and implementing robust logging, retries, and failure recovery. 

- 

Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Finance, CRM, Revenue Operations, and Support teams to translate business needs into technical solutions. 

- 

Drive continuous improvement: Proactively challenge the status quo to elevate code quality, modernize legacy codebase components, and explore new engineering tools and frameworks. 

- 

Maintain system health & observability: Debug and troubleshoot issues in production environments, managing relational database schemas (SQL) and Git/CI/CD workflows.

Experience & Background
Experience & Background
What you'll need (Must-haves)

- 

Backend development depth: 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong proficiency in backend PHP development and working with large-scale production codebases. 

- 

Database & API design skills: Solid grasp of SQL and relational databases, alongside hands-on experience designing, building, and consuming REST APIs and system-to-system integrations. 

- 

Modern frontend stack: Practical experience with TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, and modern frontend frameworks such as React. 

- 

Engineering & DevOps foundations: Familiarity with modern software development practices (Git, code reviews, automated testing) and DevOps tools like Docker and Kubernetes. 

- 

Academic foundation & communication: BSc/MSc in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience, paired with excellent written and spoken English. 

Nice-to-haves

- 

Cloud infrastructure: Experience working with Amazon Web Services (AWS). 

- 

Subscription & billing platforms: Exposure to payment gateways (e.g., Stripe) and subscription lifecycle management. 

- 

Legacy modernization & data scale: Prior experience refactoring legacy systems or handling high-volume, data-intensive applications.

postings.title: Full Stack Engineer
postings.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. 
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 


About the Role
As a Senior Software Engineer within our Commodities tribe, you will lead the end-to-end integration of US inland waterway barge data into Kpler’s global cargo intelligence platform. Operating under a "you build it, you run it" philosophy, you will design robust ingestion paths, stream real-time data using Kafka, and connect barge movement models directly to our customer-facing surfaces. This role carries genuine design authority, empowering you to solve complex entity resolution problems while mentoring peers and elevating technical craft across our crews.


Key Responsibilities
- 

Lead end-to-end integration architecture: Drive the full engineering lifecycle—from external feed ingestion and domain modeling to streaming, entity resolution, and UI distribution.

- 

Design robust ingestion & entity-resolution systems: Map incoming barge data onto Kpler reference data (vessels, zones, installations, products) using existing Elasticsearch and PostgreSQL matching patterns.

- 

Build scalable Kafka streaming pipelines: Construct event-driven contracts, schemas (Avro), deduplication mechanisms, and dead-letter queue replays with Python and Scala.

- 

Deliver data across customer surfaces: Surface integrated barge data cleanly across Elasticsearch read models, external APIs, data warehouse feeds, and the Kpler Terminal (TypeScript/Vue).

- 

Champion production quality & observability: Maintain full operational ownership of your services, setting SLOs, participating in on-call rotations, and driving post-incident improvements.

- 

Ensure data integrity & analyst alignment: Validate external feeds and integrate human-in-the-loop analyst workflows so corrections seamlessly apply to barge movements.

- 

Mentor and elevate engineering craft: Guide and mentor crew members, document architectural designs, and actively contribute to decomposing legacy estates into event-driven services.

Experience & Background
What you'll need (Must-haves)

- 

Production data engineering experience: ~5+ years of experience designing, operating, and maintaining data-intensive production systems with full ownership.

- 

Advanced Python & SQL expertise: Proven ability to build clean, well-bounded services within large, complex, and evolving codebases.

- 

Event-driven streaming proficiency: Hands-on experience with Kafka streaming in production, including schema management (Avro/Schema Registry), deduplication, and replay patterns.

- 

Third-party integration & entity resolution: Demonstrated background integrating external data feeds, managing schema mapping, and building data quality monitoring frameworks.

- 

Operational mindset: Direct experience managing production observability, writing documentation, and resolving incidents in a distributed system environment.

Nice-to-haves

- 

Functional programming & Scala: Experience or familiarity with Scala (Kafka Streams) or a track record of rapidly mastering new languages.

- 

Geospatial & domain knowledge: Familiarity with geospatial data tools (PostGIS) or exposure to maritime, logistics, or commodities domains.

- 

Modern data stack exposure: Experience with Elasticsearch, Airflow, Snowflake/lakehouse table formats, Kubernetes, and GitOps deployments.

- 

UI/Frontend collaboration: Working knowledge of TypeScript or Vue to collaborate on user-facing terminal features.

postings.title: Fullstack Engineer
postings.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. 
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 


About the Role
As a Fullstack Engineer on our Web Experience team, you will help build and evolve the frontend platform powering Kpler’s flagship products: MarineTraffic and Kpler Terminal. Working within a distributed, collaborative crew of experienced engineers, you will bridge frontend excellence with robust backend services, ensuring a unified and performant user experience for millions of global users. You will own features end-to-end, work on micro-frontend systems, and empower around 20 feature teams across the business.


Key Responsibilities
- 

Deliver end-to-end features: Build and scale client-facing, cross-domain capabilities—such as interactive maps, unified search, and custom user dashboards—from backend microservices to frontend UI. 

- 

Unify component architecture: Accelerate the migration of core applications onto Atlas, Kpler’s shared Tailwind-based design system built in Vue 3 and React. 

- 

Develop Node.js backend services: Design and maintain microservices and Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) layers that compose domain data owned by adjacent engineering teams. 

- 

Enhance developer experience: Rotate regularly into developer tooling, monorepo automation, CI pipeline optimizations, and internal support to assist feature teams building on the platform. 

- 

Leverage AI-assisted workflows: Integrate AI tools like Cursor or Claude Code into daily development, identifying opportunities to boost efficiency while maintaining architectural quality. 

- 

Promote architectural excellence: Participate in code reviews, technical pair programming, and architectural discussions grounded in Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and hexagonal architecture.

Experience & Background
What you'll need (Must-haves)

- 

Web development experience: 2–5 years of professional engineering experience building modern web applications with solid TypeScript and at least Vue or React. 

- 

Shared code ownership: Proven experience building or maintaining shared tools, component libraries, or internal frameworks that other developers rely on. 

- 

End-to-end mindset: Eagerness to take full ownership of feature lifecycles, including developing Node.js backend/BFF services when needed. 

- 

AI-assisted engineering: Hands-on experience incorporating AI development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) into your workflow with a pragmatic view of their capabilities. 

- 

Collaborative approach: A pragmatic mindset that values shipping value early, receiving feedback, and iterating over polishing in isolation. 

Nice-to-haves

- 

Modern data & mapping tech: Experience with Mapbox, GraphQL, Kafka, PostgreSQL, or Elasticsearch. 

- 

Backend languages: Familiarity or working experience with Python or Scala. 

- 

Platform & architecture patterns: Exposure to hexagonal architecture, micro-frontends, event-driven systems, or monorepos.

As a Gas and LNG Market Research Analyst, you will play a key role in shaping Kpler’s short- to medium-term supply and demand intelligence across global LNG and regional natural gas markets. At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. 
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 


About the Role
As a Machine Learning Engineer at Kpler, you will play a key role in developing and deploying predictive models that power our global commodity, energy, and maritime intelligence platforms. Working closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Product teams, you will bridge the gap between machine learning experimentation and production-grade software delivery. Your work will directly transform complex data flows into real-time, actionable insights that help world-leading trading firms, industrial leaders, and analysts make critical decisions.


Key Responsibilities
- 

Architect and deploy ML pipelines: Design, build, and maintain production-grade machine learning workflows and microservices for power market forecasting and electricity grid modeling.

- 

Bridge research and engineering: Transition statistical and machine learning prototypes from initial experimentation into scalable, production-ready Python applications.

- 

Manage time-series and event data systems: Design and optimize database schemas in PostgreSQL to handle high-throughput time-series data, event streams, and normalization routines.

- 

Implement robust MLOps practices: Establish automated model training, backtesting, evaluation, tuning, and feature/model versioning standards across deployments.

- 

Drive data engineering quality: Construct clean ingestion and transformation pipelines, ensuring high integrity, validation, and low-latency access across analytical models.

- 

Champion software excellence: Write modular, well-tested Python code, actively participating in peer code reviews, CI/CD automation, and Agile delivery processes.

Experience & Background
What you'll need (Must-haves)

- 

Software engineering foundation: Approximately two to five years of experience as a data-focused software engineer.

- 

Python mastery: Significant experience working with large production Python codebases, rather than working exclusively in notebooks.

- 

Domain knowledge: Deep understanding of electricity-grid fundamentals, including generation, transmission, and electricity markets.

- 

Data engineering & databases: Experience in data engineering, including working with PostgreSQL or similar databases, database design, data normalisation, and managing time-series and event data.

- 

DS & ML research rigor: Proven experience in data science and machine learning research, encompassing statistics, hypothesis testing, model training, evaluation, backtesting, tuning, and model selection.

- 

MLOps & versioning: Practical experience in machine learning engineering, specifically including model and feature versioning.

- 

Engineering practices & communication: Confidence working with Git, code reviews, and Agile methodologies, supported by strong written and spoken English.

Nice-to-haves

- 

Cloud platforms: Experience deploying ML workloads on AWS or GCP using Docker and Kubernetes.

- 

Workflow orchestration: Familiarity with orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, or MLflow.

- 

Streaming technologies: Exposure to real-time streaming architectures (e.g., Apache Kafka).

Drive Strategic Prospecting: Map out key decision-makers and organizational hierarchies across target New Logo maritime accounts within the EMEA region.

- Understanding of end-to-end Accounts Payable and Procure-to-Pay processes.

- Experience with procurement administration, supplier consolidation, subscription or spend reviews and contract renewals would be advantageous.

- Familiarity with systems such as Ibanfirst, Spendesk, TravelPerk, Zone, Zip or Pivot would be beneficial.

- Exposure to P2P transformation, process mapping, M&A integration or finance system implementation would be an advantage.

- Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills and a control-focused mindset.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across Finance and wider business teams.

- Highly organised and adaptable, with the ability to work independently and balance recurring operational responsibilities with project priorities.

postings.title: Product Analyst Intern – Price & Transaction
postings.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. 
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 


About the role
Price & Transaction is Kpler’s newest team. We add commodity prices to Kpler’s market data, and our main product, Kpler Arbitrage, answers one question: does it pay to ship a cargo from A to B? Is the price gap big enough to cover freight, losses, financing and quality differences? 
As a 6-month end-of-study intern in Paris, you’ll work next to our Trading Analysts, Product Managers & Engineers. You’ll run modelling studies, test new features and releases, build data-quality dashboards, and learn how physical trading works along the way.


Key Responsibilities
- Run modelling studies. Take part in data-science-style studies on our arbitrage models: test hypotheses, compare model outputs with market data, and present what you find and what it means for the product.

- Learn the business. Learn how price benchmarks, freight and quality differences combine into an arbitrage by checking the numbers our models produce. Trading Analysts explain the market logic, and you work day to day with them & engineers.

- Support the roadmap. Help our senior product team collect inputs from analysts and clients, document and size requests, and keep the backlog clear and prioritised.

- Test new features and releases. Write test cases, check outputs against what the market actually does, and log bugs and feedback with clear examples and expected behaviour.

- Build reliability dashboards that last. Design and set up dashboards tracking the freshness, coverage and quality of our price and arbitrage data, with alerts on outliers and gaps. You document them so the team can maintain them long after your internship.

- Help on data batches. Support our data batches (mappings, route and price updates): follow QA checklists, validate results before they go out, and flag anomalies early.

Experience & Background
You don't need to know it all yet. We'll teach you the market and the product. What we want is curiosity, rigour, enthusiasm for data and an interest in commodity markets.

Essential:

- Final-year student: Currently completing a Master’s degree or Grande École diploma in Engineering, Finance, Data, or an applied quantitative field, available for a 6-month end-of-study placement.

- Data-fluent: Proficient in extracting and analyzing data with SQL and/or Python, transforming raw numbers into intuitive, actionable visualizations and structured tables.

- Quality-minded: Methodical in auditing data integrity—consistently spotting anomalies or calculation gaps, applying verification checklists, and taking pride in thorough, high-quality deliverables.

- Smart with AI: Comfortable integrating AI tools into your daily workflow to move faster, while maintaining total accountability for verifying logic and verifying outputs before sharing.

- A proactive communicator: Fluent in English, comfortable working in an international team, and skilled at writing crisp, structured updates and technical bug reports.

Nice-to-haves:

- Academic coursework or project experience in statistical modeling, quantitative finance, or econometrics.

- Foundational understanding of commodity markets, physical trade flows, or trading economics.

postings.title: Product Designer - Mobile
postings.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. 
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 


About the Role
As a Mobile Product Designer at Kpler, you will help simplify the complex world of energy, commodities, and maritime data for our global clients by designing intuitive mobile experiences that surface the right information at the right moment. Focusing on both B2C and B2B audiences, you will deliver high-impact features that seamlessly integrate live vessel data, dynamic mapping, route analytics, and contextual intelligence. Collaborating closely with a design team across France, the UK, Germany, and Greece, you will push the boundaries of visual storytelling and transform complex datasets into elegant, human-centered mobile applications.


Key Responsibilities
- 

Own end-to-end mobile product design: Drive mobile products and features from initial discovery through to interactive prototypes and developer-ready specifications, supported by mentorship from senior designers. 

- 

Partner across product and engineering: Build strong working relationships with Product Managers and Engineers to align on Jobs-to-be-Done (JTBD) and clear problem definitions. 

- 

Champion and uphold our design system: Contribute to Atlas, Kpler's shared design system, ensuring visual and functional consistency across mobile, web, pages, and products. 

- 

Simplify data-dense mobile interfaces: Ensure mobile views featuring charts, tables, and geospatial mapping data remain clear, scannable, and visually compelling. 

- 

Innovate on visual storytelling: Partner with our Data Visualisation team to pioneer new patterns for presenting intricate data on mobile screens. 

- 

Iterate using user feedback and data: Leverage insights from customer feedback, usability testing, and product analytics to refine designs and inform product decisions. 

- 

Embed design in Agile delivery: Actively participate in sprint rituals, establishing design as a structured, visible contributor within the mobile squad.

Experience & Background
What you'll need (Must-haves)

- 

Mobile product design experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience delivering native or mobile-first product design. 

- 

Strong mobile interaction & platform mastery: Deep interaction design skills backed by a solid grasp of common iOS and Android patterns, behaviors, and platform conventions. 

- 

Figma & prototyping proficiency: Expertise in Figma (or comparable design tools), including interactive prototyping, with a drive to master your craft. 

- 

Process-driven design portfolio: A strong portfolio showcasing your end-to-end mobile product design process and problem-solving rationale. 

- 

Clear storytelling & communication: Strong written and verbal English skills with the ability to present compelling design narratives and structure information concisely. 

- 

Collaborative & curious mindset: Genuine enjoyment of cross-functional teamwork, a curiosity for continuous learning, and generosity in sharing knowledge with peers. 

Nice-to-haves

- 

Domain & data-rich product familiarity: Prior experience designing for maritime, navigation, geospatial mapping, or other complex, data-rich products.

- 

System design & API development: Proven track record designing RESTful APIs, distributed microservices, and high-concurrency architecture.

What you'll need (Must-haves)

- 

5+ years of professional experience building, operating, and scaling production-grade data pipelines and backend infrastructure. 

- 

Advanced expertise in Python, with a strong background refactoring and rewriting production-critical code for performance and testability. 

- 

Proven hands-on experience building and maintaining real-time or streaming API ingestion pipelines (REST, WebSockets) handling time-series datasets. 

- 

Solid production experience deploying and managing containerized applications on AWS using Docker, Kubernetes, and modern CI/CD practices. 

- 

Strong database fundamentals in SQL and experience working with distributed search or time-series databases (e.g., Elasticsearch, QuestDB, ClickHouse).

Deep experience establishing automated data quality frameworks, observability (monitoring/alerting), and root-cause troubleshooting for production systems. 

Nice-to-haves

- 

Domain knowledge of financial market structures, futures contracts, open interest, and commodities trading symbology. 

- 

Experience integrating data from major financial market vendors (e.g., Bloomberg, LSEG, Enverus, Trading Technologies). 

- 

Familiarity with legacy PHP codebase migration or reading PHP algorithms to translate into Python.

Practical familiarity with GitOps frameworks and infrastructure-as-code tooling.

As a Senior Fullstack Engineer on our Web Experience team, you will play a critical role in evolving the frontend platform behind Kpler’s flagship applications: MarineTraffic and Kpler Terminal. Working within a senior crew alongside product managers and designers, you will unify our web applications on a shared monorepo and micro-frontend architecture while building platform-level microservices that power capabilities for around 20 feature teams. Your technical leadership and engineering standards will directly shape how millions of global users interact with real-time trade, energy, and maritime intelligence.


Key Responsibilities
- Unify multi-platform user experience: Drive the migration of flagship applications onto Atlas, Kpler's component library and shared Tailwind-based design system built in Vue 3 and React. 

- 

Build platform-level microservices: Design and scale Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) layers and microservices powering maps, search, user dashboards, and preferences across web and mobile platforms. 

- 

Elevate developer experience: Empower ~20 feature teams by modernizing monorepo tooling, CI automation, migration pathways, and frontend architectural conventions. 

- 

Pioneer AI-first engineering: Integrate advanced AI development tools like Cursor and Claude Code across the engineering lifecycle to optimize workflows and boost technical velocity. 

- 

Champion architectural excellence: Architect resilient, decoupled systems leveraging hexagonal architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), event-driven patterns, and micro-frontends. 

- 

Mentor and elevate engineering craft: Guide crew members through technical documentation, code reviews, frontend chapter presentations, and biweekly developer sessions.

Experience & Background
What you'll need (Must-haves)

- 

Senior fullstack engineering experience: Proven track record of architecting, building, and operating production web applications and microservices at scale. 

- 

Core technical stack proficiency: Mastery of TypeScript across the stack, modern frontend frameworks (Vue 3, React), and backend services using Node.js. 

- 

Platform & API architecture: Deep experience with REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) patterns, and data persistence (PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Kafka). 

- 

Pragmatic delivery & platform mindset: Eagerness to balance high architectural quality with rapid, iterative product delivery that enables both end-users and developer teams. 

- 

AI-assisted engineering approach: Active hands-on experience utilizing AI development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to accelerate daily engineering workflows. 

Nice-to-haves

- 

Specialized web technologies: Experience with Mapbox, GraphQL schema federation, Python, or Scala. 

- 

Advanced architecture & tooling: Practical experience with monorepos, micro-frontends, hexagonal architecture, or Domain-Driven Design (DDD). 

- 

Design system maintenance: Experience maintaining or contributing to shared component libraries and design systems utilized across multiple teams.

Operating at the intersection of data operations, satellite imagery validation, and oil market analysis, you will ensure the precision, completeness, and strategic value of our global refined products dataset. postings.title: Senior Research Analyst, Gasoline
postings.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. 
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 


Key Responsibilities
- Drive regional market analysis: Lead structured research on East of Suez gasoline markets, linking vessel flows, refinery runs, inventory shifts, blending economics, and pricing signals into defensible market views. 

- Evaluate key supply and demand drivers: Formulate and maintain forward-looking perspectives on Chinese export quota policies, Indian and Middle Eastern export capacity, Indonesian import demand, and regional blending margins. 

- Author high-impact research publications: Write and publish regular market reports, thematic Insights, and actionable trade recommendations with clear directional calls and evidence-anchored conclusions. 

- Assess policy, mandates, and infrastructure: Track refinery turnarounds, export duties, sanctions, and regulatory shifts such as octane specifications and ethanol blending mandates to quantify their impact on inter-basin flows. 

- Audit cargo movements and blendstock flows: Cross-validate real-time vessel tracking and flow data against refinery yields, stocks, and consumption to identify blendstock misclassifications, yield anomalies, and re-export patterns. 

- Lead commercial client engagement: Present regional market views at industry conferences and client webinars, handle complex market queries, and support commercial pre-sales discussions. 

- Shape product innovation: Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to identify coverage gaps in East of Suez gasoline and blendstock benchmarks to guide the data platform roadmap.

Experience & Background
What you'll need (Must-haves):

- At least 5 years of experience in refined products research or market analysis, with deep domain expertise in Gasoline and light-end products. 

- Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline. 

- Strong technical understanding of Asia-Pacific and Middle East gasoline markets, including octane grades (RON 92/95/97), blendstocks (reformate, alkylate, MTBE, ethanol), and key trade routes. 

- Proven capability in analysing and manipulating structured datasets in Excel to build coherent market balances. 

- Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, with experience presenting complex market ideas to executive clients and external audiences. 

- Established track record of publishing independent market research notes and forming directional market views.

- Familiarity with Chinese regulatory policies, export quota mechanisms, or an existing network of market contacts across Asia.

Nice-to-haves:

- Practical familiarity with Kpler data, AIS cargo-tracking platforms, or refinery linear programming (LP) models. 

- Working knowledge of data analytics and programming tools such as Python or SQL.

As a Senior Research Analyst for Middle Distillates, you will own Kpler’s East of Suez diesel, gasoil, and jet/kerosene intelligence across the Middle East, India, China, Singapore, and the wider Asia-Pacific region. Operating at the center of global physical oil flows, you will connect regional supply dynamics to West of Suez balances through rigorous arbitrage and trade flow analysis. In this autonomous individual contributor role, your insights will set the regional editorial direction and deliver high-conviction analysis to guide commercial traders, refiners, and institutional investors worldwide.


Key Responsibilities
- Drive regional market analysis: Lead structured research across East of Suez middle distillates, integrating vessel movements, refinery runs, inventory shifts, and pricing signals into defensible market views. 

- Evaluate key supply mechanisms: Formulate comprehensive outlooks on Chinese export quota allocations, Middle Eastern and Indian export capacities, and regional margin dynamics across Singapore and South Korea.

- Audit cargo flows and refinery yields: Cross-validate real-time vessel tracking data against physical refinery throughput and stock data to identify operational anomalies, yield variations, and re-export patterns. 

- Lead client and industry engagement: Deliver technical presentations at industry conferences, lead webinars, support commercial pre-sales efforts, and resolve complex client research inquiries. 

- Influence product innovation: Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to address coverage gaps in East of Suez benchmarks and guide the enhancement of Kpler's data platforms.

Experience & Background
What you'll need (Must-haves):

- At least 5 years of professional experience analysing refined petroleum product markets, with deep domain expertise in middle distillates (diesel, gasoil, and jet/kerosene). 

- Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, Statistics, or a related quantitative field. 

- Comprehensive understanding of Asia-Pacific and Middle East refined product specifications, refinery economics, inventory dynamics, and key trade routes. 

- Advanced quantitative and data manipulation capability in Microsoft Excel, with demonstrated ability to analyze structured datasets independently.

Nice-to-haves:

- Hands-on experience working with Kpler data, AIS cargo-tracking tools, or specialized energy intelligence software. 

- Working knowledge of programming and data science languages such as Python or SQL.

postings.description:

About the Role 
 
As a Senior Tanker Research Analyst based in Singapore, you will serve as Kpler's regional authority on liquid tanker freight, driving the expansion of our maritime intelligence footprint across Asia. Sitting at the vital intersection of physical vessel tracking and commercial shipping fundamentals, you will transform raw tanker movements and freight arbitrage data into clear, forward-looking market insights. In this high-impact individual contributor role, your research will directly empower global charterers, traders, and shipowners to navigate volatile freight markets and make informed commercial decisions.


Key Responsibilities
- Drive Tanker Freight Research: Lead the development and expansion of Kpler’s tanker freight Insight product, delivering high-impact market analysis focused on Asian and global liquid freight trends. 

- Conduct Independent Market Analysis: Produce rigorous, data-driven evaluations of current and projected tanker freight dynamics utilising Kpler’s proprietary tracking platform and external industry data. 

- Author Authoritative Commentary: Publish regular in-depth written reports and timely market briefs interpreting supply/demand fundamentals, vessel utilization, and freight rate drivers. 

- Represent Kpler Externally: Deliver compelling presentations, host webinars, and participate in direct client meetings to showcase research insights to market participants and prospective clients. 

- Expand Industry Networks: Build and nurture strong commercial relationships across the regional maritime, trading, and chartering communities. 

- Partner Cross-Functionally: Collaborate closely with product managers, data engineers, and analysts to enhance freight modeling tools, while supporting sales and customer success teams during commercial engagements.

Experience & Background
What you'll need (Must-haves):

- At least 5 years of professional experience analyzing liquid tanker freight markets, with deep expertise in shipping fundamentals and commercial chartering dynamics. 

- Bachelor’s degree in a technical, quantitative, or maritime-related field (e.g., Economics, Finance, Engineering, Statistics, or Maritime Studies). 

- Deep understanding of global commodity trade flows, tanker supply/demand drivers, and freight arbitrage calculations. 

- Proven track record of independently producing and publishing insightful, high-quality written research and market commentary under deadlines. 

- Advanced data manipulation capabilities in Microsoft Excel, paired with strong analytical and logical reasoning skills across multi-layered datasets. 

- Fluent verbal and written English communication skills, with demonstrable confidence presenting to executive clients and industry stakeholders. 

Nice-to-haves:

- Direct experience using Kpler cargo-tracking data, AIS systems, or specialized maritime intelligence platforms. 

- Technical proficiency or working knowledge of data science and visualization tools such as SQL, Python, R, or Tableau. 

- Established professional network within the Asian maritime and tanker freight community.

postings.title: Treasury Specialist
postings.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. 
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 


As Kpler continues to grow, we are entering the next phase of treasury maturity, focused on strengthening governance, standardising and scaling processes, and increasing automation through systems and technology.
We are seeking a Treasury Specialist to join our Finance team and play a key role in scaling Kpler’s global treasury function. Working closely with the Treasury Manager, you will take ownership of core treasury operations across a global, multi-entity and multi-currency environment, while contributing to the continued development of our processes, controls, systems and ways of working.
This is an experienced individual contributor role, offering a high level of autonomy and ownership. You will act as a key point of expertise across cash and liquidity management, banking operations, forecasting and treasury systems, while also supporting areas such as FX risk management, funding and working capital.
You will have the opportunity to lead defined treasury projects, drive process improvements and work closely with stakeholders across Finance and the wider business. The role is well suited to an experienced treasury professional who is confident in operating independently, enjoys solving problems and wants to contribute to the ongoing maturity of a global treasury function.


Responsibilities 
- Own and optimise day-to-day treasury operations, ensuring effective cash and liquidity management across a global, multi-entity and multi-currency group.

- Monitor daily cash positions across multiple bank accounts and currencies, ensuring sufficient liquidity to meet operational and strategic needs.

- Prepare and maintain short- and mid-term cash flow forecasts, working closely with FP&A and business teams to improve forecasting accuracy.

- Execute and optimise cash transfers, funding activities, intercompany settlements and other treasury transactions.

- Manage banking operations and relationships, including bank account administration, signatories, documentation and bank account rationalisation.

- Support corporate loans, credit facilities, refinancing activities and related covenant and compliance reporting.

- Support FX risk management activities, including assessing currency exposures and executing FX spot and forward transactions and hedging strategies where applicable.

- Support the development and embedding of treasury policies, procedures, governance and control frameworks, strengthening scalability and audit readiness.

- Own and improve treasury systems and automation initiatives, driving process standardisation, efficiency and scalability across treasury operations.

- Prepare and improve treasury reporting covering cash, liquidity, debt and FX exposures, while supporting audits and maintaining strong documentation and controls.

- Analyse working capital trends and cash utilisation, identifying opportunities to improve liquidity allocation and overall treasury efficiency.

- Lead defined treasury projects with clear plans, milestones and deliverables, partnering with the Treasury Manager and Finance stakeholders on funding, expansion and international growth initiatives.

Skills and Experience 
- 5+ years of experience in SME or cash management, ideally within an international, multi-entity environment.

- Strong practical experience in cash and liquidity management, including daily cash positioning, cash transfers, funding activities and intercompany settlements.

- Proven experience with cash flow forecasting and short- to mid-term liquidity planning.

- Solid understanding of international banking structures, cross-border payments and multi-currency operations.

- Experience adhering to and improving treasury policies, procedures, controls and governance frameworks.

- Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills, with the ability to analyse financial data and build treasury reporting and models.

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy when managing sensitive financial transactions and treasury data.

- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across Finance, Legal, external banking partners and other business teams.

- Proactive and structured approach, with the ability to take ownership, manage competing priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.

- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field.

- Strong Attention to detail

Nice to have 
- Hands-on experience with Treasury Management Systems, such as Cobase, Kyriba or similar, with an ability to improve processes and drive system efficiency.

- Familiarity with FX markets, currency exposures and hedging instruments, with an understanding of financial risk management principles.

- Experience within a high-growth SaaS, fintech, commodities or multinational business with complex treasury structures.

- Experience with treasury transformation initiatives, including automation, bank connectivity or TMS implementation/enhancement.

- Familiarity with cash pooling structures, intercompany funding models and group-wide liquidity optimisation.

- Experience with ERP systems such as NetSuite or similar.

- Treasury or finance qualification such as ACT, CTP, CFA or equivalent.

- Exposure to broader corporate finance, funding or international expansion initiatives.
